frozen_configuration._comment: Phase 11 evaluation freeze. Everything that can change a release decision, pinned at the moment the held-out partition was run. A held-out result is evidence about one configuration; if any value here moves, the result describes a system that no longer exists and a new held-out partition is required. tests/test_evaluation_freeze fails when the live values drift from this file.

corpus._partition_sha256_comment: A version string alone does not freeze a corpus: the content can move under a fixed label. These digests cover every document's id, text and gold spans, so a silent edit fails the freeze test instead of quietly invalidating the held-out result.

spent_partitions.heldout_v2: reported in phase 10, then the vocabulary changed; diagnostic only

engineering_targets._comment: Project engineering targets, not legal HIPAA thresholds. Nothing here certifies compliance; they are the numbers this phase aimed at and is measured against.
